title: Tensor product of nonzero vector spaces over a field is nonzero
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $M,N$ be nonzero $k$-modules (vector spaces). Then the tensor product $M\otimes_kN$ is nonzero. [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]
